recommendations.name: DRS-OSS (drs-llm)
recommendations.description: MIT-licensed, closest open analogue to Meta's DRS: a fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B risk classifier with a gateway API, dashboard and GitHub App, though it needs GPUs and the README gives no setup steps for the GitHub App.

recommendations.name: VulGuard
recommendations.description: Mines your repo's commit history, labels bug/vulnerability-inducing commits with V-SZZ and trains/infers with eight just-in-time prediction models; research-oriented, license not confirmed.

recommendations.name: JITBot
recommendations.description: An explainable GitHub-app style just-in-time defect prediction bot that scores commits in pull requests, but its source may no longer be public, so treat it as a reference design.
